Usage: navlyn-mcp --workspace <path|auto> [options]

Options:
  --workspace <path|auto>        Required .slnx, .sln, or .csproj path, or auto to discover one.
  --navlyn-executable <command>  Navlyn CLI command or executable. Defaults to navlyn.
  --navlyn-arg <arg>             Prefix argument for local dev, repeatable.
  --working-directory <path>     Child process working directory.
  --timeout-ms <number>          Per-tool timeout. Defaults to 120000.
  --max-json-chars <number>      Max CLI stdout JSON chars. Defaults to 4000000.
